card.name: Just before a dosage form word
card.fires_on: Words and word parts right before a dosage form such as injection, capsules, tablets or oral solution, often inside a brand or drug name or after a link like a, and or of.

modes.label: Inside brand or drug names
modes.description: Last part of a brand or drug name just before 'for Injection' or a similar form.
modes.example: TEMOD<<AR>> for injection with other intravenous substances or

modes.label: Linking word before a form
modes.description: A small linking word or hyphenated term that comes before a form like tablets, capsules or water.

modes.label: Component of a named product
modes.description: The word a after a drug name and comma, introducing a combination product.
modes.example: empagliflozin,<< a>> component of SYNJARDY or SYN

card.writes: It promotes tablet and granule words, so it pushes the model to predict a dosage form noun next.
card.plain: It fires where the text is about to name a dosage form like tablets or capsules.
